blocks.orig: Tanzania is chosen as the world’s best safari country, but it is also an expensive country. Unfortunately, we cannot change that. What we can do is give you a breakdown of the costs of a safari, so you get a better understanding. How much does safari cost?
blocks.html: Tanzania has been voted the best safari country in the world, yet it is also a costly place to travel. That is not something we can change. What we can do is break down what a safari actually costs, so you know where your money goes. So, how much does a safari cost?

blocks.orig: The factors that make up for the total cost of a Tanzanian safari:
blocks.html: These are the elements that together determine the total price of a safari in Tanzania:

blocks.orig: Rent of safari vehicle & private guide
blocks.html: Hire of the safari vehicle & a private guide

blocks.orig: The first two factors are fixed prices, unless you choose to share the safari vehicle with more people. The entrance fees for the national parks are expensive, for example the costs of driving with a safari jeep in the Ngorongoro Crater are 300 US-Dollars per day excl. 78.50 US-Dollars per person. This makes a safari a costly journey. It is possible to save money on accommodation, depending on the level of luxury/exclusiveness you choose.
blocks.html: The first two elements are fixed, unless you decide to share the safari vehicle with a larger group. The park entrance fees are steep: driving a safari jeep into the Ngorongoro Crater, for example, costs 300 US-Dollars per day, on top of 78.50 US-Dollars per person. That is what makes a safari such an expensive trip. Where you can save is on accommodation, depending on how much luxury or exclusivity you want.

blocks.orig: The average costs for a safari are roughly starting from $520,- per person per day if you choose the Silver Class Hotels. Even if you go on safari with 4 people, the costs will be around $450 per person per day.
blocks.html: On average, a safari starts at roughly $520,- per person per day when you stay in the Silver Class Hotels. Even when four of you travel together, you should still count on around $450 per person per day.

blocks.orig: Our Silver Class accommodation has the best price-quality balance. These hotels/lodges/  camps are located at beautiful locations with awesome views and a good service and price. The Silver Class accommodation is surely no budget accommodation. If you choose a budget accommodation, you can save 15 to 30 US-Dollars per day, but you comprise on the quality and location. We always recommend our Silver Class hotels, so you can enjoy the accommodation at its fullest. blocks.html: Our Silver Class accommodation offers the best balance between price and quality. These hotels, lodges and camps sit in lovely spots with great views, good service and fair prices. Silver Class is certainly not budget accommodation. Opting for budget accommodation instead saves you 15 to 30 US-Dollars a day, but you give up quality and location. We always suggest our Silver Class hotels, so you get the most out of where you stay. Your Tanzania Trip has 4 staff members who regularly inspect the accommodations, so we are confident we offer you the best.

blocks.orig: If you really want to overnight on budget, and the Silver Class hotels are too expensive, we advise you to go camping. Tanzania has a lot of good camping sites where you can stay in small dome tents.
blocks.html: If you genuinely need to keep overnight costs down and the Silver Class hotels are beyond your budget, our advice is to go camping. Tanzania has plenty of good campsites where you can sleep in small dome tents.

blocks.orig: In contrary to safari accommodation on the mainland, Zanzibar is much cheaper. On this tropical island, you can stay in our Silver Class accommodation for only $40 per person, per night. The lodge we selected is located at the beach in Zanzibar’s most beautiful village.
blocks.html: Compared with safari accommodation on the mainland, Zanzibar is considerably cheaper. On this tropical island our Silver Class accommodation costs just $40 per person, per night. The lodge we chose sits right on the beach in the most beautiful village on Zanzibar.

blocks.orig: We always recommend our guests to determine their safari budget. How much do you want to spend on a safari? And do you like to end your safari with a beach holiday on Zanzibar? It makes it easier to create an itinerary that suits you.
blocks.html: We always encourage our guests to settle on a safari budget first. How much are you prepared to spend on a safari? And would you like to finish your safari with a beach holiday on Zanzibar? Knowing this makes it much easier to put together an itinerary that fits you.
